title: Goldreich–Levin Work Budget Bound
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$ and every rational threshold $0<\\tau\\le1$, the Goldreich–Levin work budget, viewed as a rational number, satisfies $\\operatorname{WorkBudget}(n,\\tau)\\le 2^{25}n(n+1)^2/\\tau^8$.
